details:
Had this issue for 5 months now, where while using a Valve Index, I would get a grey screen for few second and I would lose tracking, it would only happen when looking at some avatars or worlds (Unsure what specific things would trigger it)
But its bad, it happens every 3-4 seconds and the spikes are 2 seconds or longer of grey screen and tracking issues.
I thought this is an issue with the game, but my friend had the same issue with the same setup.
To trigger these lag spikes where the screen goes gray for few second you need to have a 2560 x 1440 75hz monitor.
To fix these lag spikes you need to set your monitor resolution to 1920x1080 60hz, not the game the whole windows resolution and that will fix it.
I have a 2 1080p and 1 1440p monitor setup so i'm not sure if this issue still happens with 1 2560 x 1080 monitor (I have also tested with 1 1080p and 1 1440p monitor and the issue still persists.
Devs please look into this screen size bug thing, it was really confused because I thought some avatars where bugged, but it was an issue with my screen size.
title: Valve Index lag and losing tracking constantly on PC + Fix
